name: The Paper Lighthouse of Lost Letters
description: A lighthouse built from folded paper ships and blank envelopes, guiding lost wishes home.
prompt: A tall lighthouse made of folded paper boats and blank cream envelopes standing on a rocky coast, beams of soft gold light, sea mist, paper seabirds circling, twilight sky with gentle stars, melancholic but hopeful mood, intricate paper textures, cinematic lighting, single image, no readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
caption: For every wish that lost its way, a light remains. 🕯️🌊
